summary.intent: Backfill GSD tracking state for phases 38 and 39 that were shipped outside the GSD workflow, then commit and PR the planning doc changes.
summary.outcome: Created 6 stub SUMMARY files and updated 2 CONTEXT files to mark both phases complete, committed on a docs branch with a PR targeting main.

repo: Phases 38 (Retire deprecated web services) and 39 (User-configurable vault parameters) were shipped via PRs #422 and #423 without going through the GSD execution workflow, leaving planning state stale.
GSD completion tracking is driven by the presence of SUMMARY.md files alongside PLAN.md files — no summary means the plan is counted as incomplete regardless of actual ship state.
The tag-staging.yml workflow was updated in the same main sync (fb90ceb..df6824af) that landed the staging-20260401-release-1 tag, adding the cipherbox-.*-v regex fix from the earlier PR.
workflow: When work is done outside the GSD workflow, stub SUMMARY files must be manually created to keep /gsd:stats accurate — the tool has no way to infer completion from git history.
Phase CONTEXT.md files also need their status field updated independently from SUMMARY creation; the two are not linked automatically.
PR descriptions were used as the authoritative source of truth for what each plan accomplished when writing stub summaries.

friction: GSD stats showed phases 38 and 39 as incomplete/planned even though both were already shipped, requiring manual backfill rather than automatic reconciliation with git/PR history.
Phase 38 had no summaries at all (plans existed but were never executed through GSD), making the discrepancy invisible until the user noticed the stats were wrong.
open_items: The docs branch and PR were created but not yet merged — needs review/merge to land the planning state fixes.
v1.1 milestone is at 92% phases / 94% plans with 4 requirements still open — some cleanup may remain before milestone close.
